Definition: Shobal, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shobal = "flowing"; 1) the 2nd son of Seir the Horite (Edom) and one of the dukes of the Horites; 2) son of Caleb, grandson of Hur, and founder of Kirjath-jearim; 3) a Judaite, son of Hur and a descendant of Caleb; 3a) possibly the same as 2
